name: vb-hidden-feature-2026-11-07
purpose: Replay of the Visual Bible authoring step with HIDDEN_FEATURE_STATE_RULE (docs/decisions.md 2026-11-07). 20 stored beats-path stories on the STAGING database, two with a feature hidden until a reveal page, eighteen with none. Measures: rate of correct hidden/revealed state pairs on the positives, rate of false hidden/revealed states on the negatives.
basis: Positives: story text read by hand (pages quoted in `evidence`). Negatives: storyText scanned for hide/reveal/uncover cues (de/fr/it/en); every hit was read and none is a feature of a Visual Bible entry that the story hides and then shows (an object put under leaves, a child hiding behind a sibling, a map found under a stone are placements of a thing, not a hidden feature of an entry). The negatives were NOT each read end to end: a miss is possible, so a hidden/revealed state the replay produces on a negative is hand-checked against the story text before it is counted as false.

stories.evidence: Page 7 text: 'die lange Stirnmaehne rutschte zurueck, und ein helles Horn kam zum Vorschein'. Stored bible: one entry, no states.

expected.revealedPages: 9-10 (page 9: the leaves slide off, the horn shows)

stories.evidence: Page 3: 'An seiner Stirn steckten Blaetter, so dicht, dass man nicht sah, was darunter war'. Page 9: 'Die Blaetter rutschten ab'; Melodi: 'Er hat ein Horn!'. Stored bible: states unaltered@3,4,5,8 and glowing horn@9, no covered state.
